display_name: Where the chain of command sits: the Kesmark district (theatre_pannonia)
source: game value: a fictional district on the air war's theatre (each place stands at a place of the country map, place_map, F1; km east and north of its origin); the kinds of post and office follow docs/research/CHAIN_OF_COMMAND_RESEARCH_2026-10.md
notes: The map the player's character moves on: the small city of Novo Varosd (the army's headquarters, the national air defence sector's bunker, the works), the town of Kesmark (the bridges the battery defends, the garrison commandant, civil defence, the police, the station, the sugar factory), five villages, the regiment's posts in the woods and fields, the radar posts on the hills, the air base. kind: city, town, village, industrial, civil (an office in a settlement), military_post, infrastructure, countryside. settlement: the city, town or village it is in ('' in the countryside); urban places suffer what utin_2018 §9.3 says of signals in a city. theatre_object: a theatre object it stands at (its position is taken from the object, and follows it when the object moves: the battery's command post moves with the battery).

places.notes: The district's small city: the army's headquarters, the hospital, the station, the engineering works.

places.name: Battery 21's prepared position south of Vrbice
places.notes: Open fields 500 m east of the Vrbice road, 11 km further from the Warsaw Pact's front than the position at the bridges: a line of the division's prepared positions in depth (vr_poltikovic_1984 p. 96: 3-4 a division, its lines 6-8 km apart), where the regiment moves the battery when the division withdraws (data/campaign/tasking.json withdraw_with_division). The place is SAM3D's.

places.name: Battery 21's prepared position east of the Rava on the Tiszavar road
places.notes: Fields 600 m south of the Tiszavar road east of the Rava, 9 km further from NATO's front than the position at the bridges: as bty21_depth_south, the line in depth against a war from the west. The place is SAM3D's.
